description_for_human: 8D coaching, FMEA review, NCR writing, root cause analysis, and ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 internal audit. Powered by Quality-Engineering-Skills.
description_for_model: Quality engineering methodology assistant. Use this plugin when the user asks about: 8D problem solving (D0-D8), FMEA (PFMEA, DFMEA, Action Priority), NCR (non-conformance report) writing, root cause analysis (5-Why, fishbone, Is/Is-Not), corrective action (CAR, PDCA), ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 internal audit. Applies automotive supplier quality standards: ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949:2016, AIAG-VDA FMEA 2019.

functions.name: coach_8d
functions.description: Generate a new single-turn D0 8D coaching question. This experimental API stores no session, enforces no step-transition state and does not advance D1–D8. Use for an initial 8D prompt; use the declarative agent for guided conversation.

complaint_description.description: Brief description of the defect or customer complaint to investigate

functions.name: evaluate_8d
functions.description: Evaluate a provided 8D report. Returns a structured schema-validated Pass/Fail for D0–D8, overall quality and up to three issues. Malformed model output fails closed; do not treat it as validated evidence.

functions.name: root_cause_analysis
functions.description: Generate one new 5-Why question from the problem statement. This optional API is stateless, not a persistent RCA session.

functions.name: write_ncr
functions.description: Draft an objective-evidence NCR. Model result must conform to structured generated_text/severity/flags schema.

functions.name: audit_guide
functions.description: Generate one open audit question for an ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 scope. This experimental API stores no audit session or evidence-gate state.

scope.description: Audit scope — full QMS, specific clauses, or specific process

functions.name: fmea_review
functions.description: Review PFMEA/DFMEA content. Model result must conform to structured generated_text/flags schema.

fmea_text.description: FMEA content or description to review
